name: Cleanup
description: Free up disk space by moving caches, logs and developer leftovers to the Trash

commands.name: Clean Up
commands.description: Find caches, logs and temp files you can move to the Trash
commands.trigger: clean up cleanup cache caches temp logs free space disk storage

commands.name: Developer Cleanup
commands.description: Clear Xcode DerivedData and package-manager caches
commands.trigger: developer cleanup xcode deriveddata npm pnpm cargo gradle cache dev

commands.name: Find App Leftovers
commands.description: Review data left behind by apps you've uninstalled
commands.trigger: app leftovers uninstalled remnants orphaned data support files cleanup

commands.name: Disk Space Analyzer
commands.description: See which folders in your home directory use the most space
commands.trigger: disk space analyzer usage storage large files folders size what is using

commands.name: Network Cleanup
commands.description: Flush the DNS and network address caches
commands.trigger: network cleanup flush dns cache arp reset connection

commands.name: Empty Trash
commands.description: Permanently delete everything in the Trash to free up space
commands.trigger: empty trash recycle bin bin delete permanently free space
